title: Qman DirectPath signed DeviceTaxonomyDefinition
description: Immutable taxonomy and exact classifier provenance for the five supported qualification archetypes. It prevents a QualificationRecord or catalog entry from self-declaring its own device class.

archetypeSet.x-qmanCanonicalOrder: ascending precedence; precedence and archetype are independently unique

x-qmanArchetypeRule: The five archetype IDs are exhaustive for qualification routing, not HCL support claims. The classifier evaluates definitions in unique ascending precedence and must emit exactly one class; GENERIC_PCI is the explicit final fallback, never an implicit wildcard. description is explanatory only. qualificationCaseProfileId selects a separately pinned qualification-case matrix; it cannot waive mandatory cases or confer SUPPORTED status.
x-qmanClassifierRule: Resolve classifier.path+symbol at target commit C and exactly one integration-map symbol row whose path/symbol match, whose GIT_BLOB_BYTES interfaceHash equals classifier.blobSha256 and whose symbolSemanticHash equals classifier.symbolSemanticHash. Independently require classifier.interfaceContractDigest = SHA-256(RFC-8785-JCS of {protocol,argvOrder:[taxonomy,hostSnapshot,deviceRecord,classificationContext,output],environment:{LC_ALL:C.UTF-8,TZ:UTC},network:DENY_ALL,inputContracts,outputContract}); blob, symbol-semantic and interface-contract digests are not interchangeable. Verify the signed DeviceClassificationContext, form exactly RFC-8785-JCS(record.classificationContext), write those bytes to a fresh temporary input whose path is excluded from identity, and invoke the verified classifier directly with --taxonomy, --host-snapshot, --device-record, --context and --output. The process has an empty environment except LC_ALL=C.UTF-8/TZ=UTC, no shell/network, read-only signed inputs and one new output; it may not read a clock, random source, signer service or undeclared identifier. Output bytes equal RFC-8785-JCS of the deterministic construction record whose signedAt/classificationDigest/signature are null; presentation whitespace, alternate key order or merely equivalent JSON is invalid. The authority then supplies signedAt, recomputes the digest and signs. The final output validates against the fixed classification-record schema and normative raw schema hash.
x-qmanReplayIsolationRule: A release verifier MUST NOT execute classifier or dependency bytes directly on the verifier host. Replay uses only an independently configured trusted isolation runner outside the target repository, mapping and evidence: exact target architecture/runtime, complete verified source/build/runtime/dependency closure mounted read-only, exactly taxonomy/snapshot/device/context inputs, one bounded output, no-new-privileges, deny-all network, no host filesystem/device/credential access, no undeclared child process, and explicit CPU/memory/process/file/time limits. The runner returns immutable output/exit/isolation attestation bound to all hashes; the verifier requires byte equality with the retained deterministic construction projection. Missing/incompatible runner, incomplete closure or direct-exec fallback fails closed whenever a DeviceClassificationRecord is consumed.
x-qmanBuildRule: Reconstruct sourceTree and resolve the signed BuildAttestation. It byte-equals C/M/portable/source tree, uses consumerKind=TAXONOMY_CLASSIFIER and consumerBuildId=classifier.manifestId, and emits TAXONOMY_CLASSIFIER_BINARY or TAXONOMY_CLASSIFIER_SOURCE matching executionEnvironment.mode. Runtime/dependency/environment/build-log descriptors equal the attestation projections; attestation time precedes issuedAt. A mutable tool label or digest without source/build/runtime closure is invalid.
x-qmanAcyclicRule: This definition is created before any classification or qualification run. It contains no inventory instance, device UID/record hash, run/request/result, Measurement, Scenario, Subject, QualificationRecord, SupportedCatalog, CaseCompletionRecord or release digest. Classification records point to this definition; it never points forward to them.
x-qmanSignatureRule: Set definitionDigest and signature to null, RFC-8785 canonicalize the complete closed definition, store SHA-256 of those bytes in definitionDigest, and sign ASCII(QMAN-DIRECTPATH/DEVICE-TAXONOMY-DEFINITION/V1) || 0x00 || the same bytes with a non-revoked QUALIFICATION_ENGINEERING key.
